decision: SysML 8.2.2.6.2 states UsageDeclaration : Usage = Identification FeatureSpecializationPart?. The SysML Xtext delegates to a FeatureDeclaration fragment whose body is not in this pack, so it is not read as a disagreement about the language; the rule is the clause as written.
